slides.4.title: 🧠 Knowledge Check
slides.4.questions.0.question: How many administrative regions in Italy produce wine?
slides.4.questions.0.explanation: All 20 of Italy's administrative regions produce wine, making it the most diverse wine-producing country in the world, with each region having its own signature appellations.
slides.4.questions.1.question: How many native grape varieties does Italy have?
slides.4.questions.1.explanation: Italy boasts over 350 indigenous varieties — far more than any other wine country — representing an unrivalled reservoir of viticultural diversity.
slides.4.questions.2.question: Which of the following are important wine-producing regions of northern Italy? (Multiple choice)
slides.4.questions.2.explanation: Piemonte, Veneto, and Lombardy are all located in northern Italy. Sicily is a southern island region, home to Nero d'Avola and Etna wines.
slides.4.questions.3.question: What is the highest classification level in the Italian wine system?
slides.4.questions.3.explanation: DOCG (Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita) is the highest tier. It requires an official quality guarantee in addition to the controlled designation of origin, and currently covers over 77 zones.
slides.4.questions.4.question: Which of the following correctly describe Italy's global standing in wine? (Multiple choice)
slides.4.questions.4.options.0: A. World's No.1 wine exporter by volume
slides.4.questions.4.options.2: C. Only northern regions produce great wine
slides.4.questions.4.options.3: D. Over 4,000 years of winemaking history
slides.4.questions.4.explanation: Italy is the world's top wine exporter by volume, has over 350 native varieties, and a millennia-long winemaking tradition. Southern regions like Sicily also produce outstanding wines.

quiz.0.question: How many native grape varieties does Italy have?
quiz.0.explanation: Italy has over 350 native grape varieties, making it one of the most diverse wine-producing nations in the world.
quiz.1.question: How many DOCGs and DOCs does Italy have in total?
quiz.1.explanation: Italy has 74 DOCGs and 334 DOCs, totalling over 400 designated wine zones.
quiz.2.question: Approximately what percentage of Italian wine production is red wine?
quiz.2.explanation: Red wine accounts for roughly 60% of Italian production, white wine about 35%, and sparkling wine about 5%.
quiz.3.question: Which of the following is NOT a major northern Italian region?
quiz.3.explanation: Sicily is a southern island region, not northern Italy.
